description: Read the page of one Instagram or TikTok creator, as the web app shows it at /ig/@handle, /tt/@handle, or /@handle. Pass handle with platform for a platform handle, or handle alone for a claimed handle; a creator whose verified claim holds a claimed handle answers with its /@handle page. Returns path; claimed, whether a verified handle claim covers the creator; profile, with the creator's id for reveal_contact, name, bio, country, followerCount, postCount, audience countries, posting activity, recent views, hasContact, and newest posts, each with a thumbnailUrl that expires within an hour, so call again for fresh links; related, the similar creators the page lists, each with its claimed handle or null; searches, the published searches that list the creator; and reveal, the contact address once the caller's organization revealed it, otherwise locked. Reading it spends nothing. A handle no catalog creator has returns not_found. Works without a credential, and reveal is then locked.

platform.description: ig for Instagram or tt for TikTok; omit to read a claimed handle, the page at /@handle

name: get_creator
title: Get creator
